summary: Galician distinguishes ser and estar with its own language-specific boundaries; haber supplies central existential meanings and ter is the ordinary possession verb.

semantic_map.SEM.CHARACTERISTIC_PROPERTY: ser for many characteristic/classificatory properties; adjective-specific contrasts require review
semantic_map.SEM.CURRENT_STATE: estar for many states and situational conditions
semantic_map.SEM.RESULTANT_STATE: estar + adjective/participle in many result-state readings; lexical/adjective-specific behavior requires review
semantic_map.SEM.EVENT_LOCATION: ser / ter lugar according to event construction
semantic_map.SEM.EXISTENCE_PRESENCE: impersonal haber, especially hai, or lexical existir according to meaning
semantic_map.SEM.ORIGIN_AFFILIATION: ser de / origin or affiliation predicate
semantic_map.SEM.POSSESSION_AS_EXISTENCE: not default; ter is ordinary possession
